html:
At Silver Touch Hospitals, we see many patients who have been suffering from knee pain for years, having attempted every avenue of treatment short of surgery. Some have heard of the newest development, which is robotic knee replacement surgery in Ahmedabad, but do not know if it is appropriate for them.

Let us make sense of what it truly entails, who it is designed for, and what you need to understand prior to making a decision.

What Is Robotic Knee Replacement?

Robotic knee replacement is not done by a robot independently. It’s your orthopedic surgeon still doing the operation.

The robotic platform serves as an extremely accurate guide, assisting your surgeon in planning and carrying out every step with millimeter accuracy. The technology scans your joint structure in real-time and assists in placing the new knee implant precisely where it needs to go.

This accuracy assists in making your new knee feel better and function better. It also results in less damage to surrounding soft tissue, smaller wounds, and quicker recovery in most instances.

Who Is It Suitable For?

If you have severe arthritis, chronic knee pain, stiffness, or deformity of the joint that restricts your everyday movement, robotic knee replacement could benefit you.

It’s particularly useful for individuals who wish to continue being active post-surgery or have intricately constructed knee anatomy.

At Silver Touch Hospitals, our orthopedic specialist examines each patient separately. We examine X-rays, medical history, and lifestyle before opting for any plan of surgery. The intention is always to regain mobility effectively and safely.

What Are the Risks?

Similar to any surgery, robotic knee replacement poses some risks, including infection, blood clots, or stiffness. But the risk of surgical mistakes or misalignment is significantly less due to robot-assisted guidance. Patients tend to have less pain and require fewer revision surgeries down the road.

What About the Cost?

The price of robotic knee replacement varies based on various factors, such as your overall condition, hospital stay, and type of implant. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we keep transparency at the core of everything. We give a clear cost estimate in advance and assist patients in knowing the possible options under insurance or government health schemes.

Why Choose Silver Touch Hospitals

Our orthopedic facility pairs skilled surgeons, cutting-edge imaging centers, and caring post-surgical support. Each patient is given individualized guidance, from diagnosis through recovery, to ensure that they are comfortable at every stage of their journey toward pain-free movement.
